subject: Document coordination conflict on the Section 08 71 00 interior door hardware set at the

messages.text: Shop drawings for the Section 08 71 00 interior door hardware set at the stair enclosure are ready to submit, but what's shown doesn't match what's built out in the field mockup -- can you confirm which governs? We would like this closed out ahead of the next submittal deadline. This could affect the contract sum depending on the resolution. This could affect the submittal review schedule. There is no specific deadline for this, but a timely response is appreciated.

Door and Window Schedule A-601 is the condition to build to for the Section 08 71 00 interior door hardware set at the stair enclosure; we'll reconcile Sheet A-301 by addendum. This could affect the contract sum depending on the resolution. This could affect the submittal review schedule.
